name: knights
description: Knights of the Round Table runtimes (pi-knight, claude-knight) and shared core

scripts.build: npm run build -w @roundtable/knight-core && npm run build --workspaces --if-present
scripts.typecheck: npm run build -w @roundtable/knight-core && npm run typecheck --workspaces --if-present && tsc -p scripts/dev && tsc -p tsconfig.tests.json
scripts.test: npm run build -w @roundtable/knight-core && npm run test --workspaces --if-present
scripts.test:hermetic: npm run build -w @roundtable/knight-core && npm run test:hermetic --workspaces --if-present
